description: Compliance-by-design profiles. Selecting a profile injects its controls into requirements, architecture and every builder prompt, and drives a compliance-audit pass that produces a control-to-implementation matrix (COMPLIANCE.md). Controls are intentionally concise and buildable; they are guidance for the agents, not a substitute for a formal audit.

pci-dss.label: PCI-DSS v4.0 (payment card data)
pci-dss.summary: Controls for handling payment card data.

controls.title: Do not store PAN
controls.requirement: Never persist full primary account numbers; tokenize via a payment provider (e.g. Stripe) and store only tokens.

controls.title: Encrypt cardholder data in transit
controls.requirement: Enforce TLS 1.2+ everywhere; HSTS enabled; no plaintext transport.

controls.title: Encrypt sensitive data at rest
controls.requirement: Encrypt any stored sensitive data at rest (DB/disk encryption).

controls.title: Least-privilege access
controls.requirement: Role-based access control; unique accounts; no shared admin credentials.

controls.title: Audit trails
controls.requirement: Log access to cardholder-data functions with user, timestamp and action; protect logs from tampering.

controls.title: No hardcoded secrets
controls.requirement: Keys and credentials from a secrets manager/env, never committed.

controls.title: Encrypt PHI in transit and at rest
controls.requirement: TLS in transit; encryption at rest for all PHI fields/stores.

controls.title: Access controls & unique IDs
controls.requirement: Unique user identification, RBAC, automatic session timeout/logoff.

controls.title: Audit controls
controls.requirement: Record and examine access/activity on PHI; tamper-evident audit log.

controls.title: Minimum necessary
controls.requirement: Expose only the minimum PHI needed; no PHI in logs, URLs or analytics.

controls.title: Integrity
controls.requirement: Protect PHI from improper alteration/destruction; validation and referential integrity.

controls.title: Business Associate Agreements
controls.requirement: Document that any third-party processor handling PHI requires a BAA (note in COMPLIANCE.md).

controls.title: Logical access controls
controls.requirement: Authentication, RBAC, least privilege, MFA hooks for privileged actions.

controls.title: Encryption
controls.requirement: Encrypt data in transit (TLS) and sensitive data at rest.

controls.title: Monitoring & audit logging
controls.requirement: Centralized structured logs, audit trail of security-relevant events.

controls.title: Change management
controls.requirement: CI with automated tests and security scans gating merges.

controls.title: Availability
controls.requirement: Health checks, graceful error handling, backups/retention documented.

controls.title: Secret management
controls.requirement: Secrets from a vault/managed identity; none in source.

controls.title: Data minimization
controls.requirement: Collect only necessary personal data; document purpose per field.

controls.title: Consent & cookie banner
controls.requirement: Consent capture for optional processing; cookie banner; privacy policy page.

controls.title: Right to erasure & export
controls.requirement: Endpoints to export and delete a user's personal data (right to be forgotten).

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.requirement: Encrypt personal data in transit and at rest; pseudonymize where possible.

controls.title: Retention limits
controls.requirement: Configurable retention and automatic purge of expired personal data.

controls.title: Audit & breach readiness
controls.requirement: Access logs for personal data to support breach notification.

controls.title: Access control
controls.requirement: RBAC, least privilege, strong authentication, session management.

controls.title: Cryptography
controls.requirement: TLS in transit; encryption at rest; documented key management.

controls.title: Logging & monitoring
controls.requirement: Event logging, protection of log information, clock synchronization.

controls.title: Secure development
controls.requirement: Input validation, secure defaults, dependency and SAST scanning in CI.

controls.title: Secrets & key management
controls.requirement: No secrets in code; managed secret storage.

controls.title: Backup & resilience
controls.requirement: Backup strategy and health checks documented.
